desc: Reduce to 26 frequencies and derive fixed-k model: target x_i∈{0,k}, base cost Σ|f_i−x_i|, adjacent change saving min(max(0,f_i−x_i), max(0,x_{i+1}−f_{i+1})).
Justify additivity/no double counting: a letter cannot have both surplus and deficit, and chains beyond one adjacent move tie delete+insert, so sum of edge savings is valid.
Implement the fixed-k two-state DP over 26 letters, enumerate k=0..max(f), handle k=0, return global minimum.
Run the brute-force cross-check (n≤7 over {a,b,c} plus z-heavy strings, examples "acab"/"wddw"/"aaabc") and report PASS/FAIL with first counterexample; confirmed no z→a wrap saving is taken.
No mismatch appeared; DP transition/edge-saving formula validated against independent subset enumeration.
